text: The holder of credential CRD_001232, revoked on 2022-12-30, has billed 62 claims since revocation, the first of them 933 days after the licence was pulled. The volume is the anomaly: revoked-but-rostered doctors in this economy typically taper off below 30 claims, and 62 is the largest post-revocation caseload in the graph. The long gap cuts both ways — it argues against a paperwork lag and instead suggests billing resumed or accelerated long after the revocation should have ended it. A genuine alternative is that this doctor's patient volume is driven by a high-throughput referral channel rather than by the doctor's own conduct, so the credential violation may be the clinic's rostering failure rather than deliberate laundering. Next step: identify who routes this doctor's patients and whether the rostering clinic verified the credential at any point after 2022.
